entities.name: Leviathan
entities.description: Immense whale-like creatures with enormous mouths, mainly blue-aligned, found across many planes.

entities.name: Llawan
entities.description: Empress who led her own personal leviathan into battle in the Mer Empire civil war.

entities.name: Mer Empire civil war
entities.description: Civil war in which Empress Llawan fought with a leviathan.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker who fought a demonic leviathan in the first duel between planeswalkers on Dominaria and fed on its remains.

entities.name: Demonic Leviathan
entities.description: Leviathan Bolas fought on young Dominaria; the fight lasted a month and created the first spatial rift.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane where Bolas fought the demonic leviathan.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: Part of Dominaria reduced to a third of its size by the duel.

entities.name: Talon Gates
entities.description: Remains of the demonic leviathan after Bolas feasted.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Mirrodin ruler whose soul traps likely brought leviathans to Mirrodin.

entities.name: Simic
entities.description: Ravnican guild that bred airborne predatory leviathans like the Nimbus Swimmer and Sky Swallower.

entities.name: Segovian Leviathan
entities.description: Largest creature on the miniature plane of Segovia.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas fights a demonic leviathan for a month in the first planeswalker duel, creating the first spatial rift.
events.quote: The fight lasted a month, reduced Madara to a third of its original size, and created the first spatial rift

events.summary: Bolas feasts on the leviathan's remains for a year, absorbing its power.
events.quote: Bolas feasted on the remains of the leviathan over the course of a year

events.summary: Empress Llawan leads her personal leviathan into battle.
events.quote: Empress Llawan led her own personal leviathan into battle

events.summary: Memnarch uses leviathans with his Levelers against organic civilizations.
events.quote: Memnarch used them together with his Levelers against the organic civilizations

relations.quote: Bolas feasted on the remains of the leviathan
The Simic created several predatory leviathans

relations.note: Led her own leviathan in battle
relations.quote: Empress Llawan led her own personal leviathan into battle
